Shopping Sessions is being rescored, please see the rules page!
IDs now use a per-seed keyed bijection + 1-in-8 32-char hex suffixes (same pipeline rules, re-download generator.zip / dev-answer.zip / rules.md). We're automatically rescoring every team's best entry onto v5, and Sunday's quiet finals rescore is now top 30 in interleaved rounds across 3 fresh 60M datasets (9 runs total).Read in full · 4 earlier
Shopping Sessions is being rescored, please see the rules page! / Sat 9:08 PM
IDs now use a per-seed keyed bijection + 1-in-8 32-char hex suffixes (same pipeline rules, re-download generator.zip / dev-answer.zip / rules.md). We're automatically rescoring every team's best entry onto v5, and Sunday's quiet finals rescore is now top 30 in interleaved rounds across 3 fresh 60M datasets (9 runs total).
New rule: excessive code reuse may result in disqualification / Sat 6:23 PM
Your entry should be your team's own work. Excessive reuse of code, another team's entry included, may result in disqualification, at the organizers' discretion. Open-source libraries are still fine. Only your final entry counts, so you have until 11:00 AM ET Sunday to make sure it is your own. Rules: https://www.joinbuilders.org/buildathon#rules
RWX, Databricks, and Mech Royale hourly quotas have been increased, godspeed! / Sat 4:06 PM
See status page for live quotas, quotas may be reduced at any time. We are trying to keep it fair.
Like and comment our LinkedIn post! / Fri 7:45 PM

May the odds be ever in your favor! / Fri 6:03 PM
